'''Speaker''' was a position among the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] society. A Speaker was an elder of a Verpine hive who was authorized to speak for the collective. Speaker [[Jurfel]] was a Verpine allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and involved with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] [[Shantipole Project]].<ref name="SFS" />
